newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.7500/7600 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday as demand for the U.S. currency outweighed supply, dealers said.
Dealers said the taka opened weaker and remained under pressure throughout the day as importers crowded the dollar-scarce market.

The call money rates closed lower at six to 6.5 percent aginst a previous seven to nine percent. Call rates fell as the market received about 540 million taka against matured central bank bills. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
